subject: Evidence: employee training, background checks, and offboarding controls
messages:
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: evidence for employee training & background checks

Hi Ben,

As part of our SIG/CAIQ review and our SOC 2 onboarding checklist, the security team asked for documentation showing your people controls for new hires and leavers. Specifically we need: a) proof of mandatory security awareness training completion for the last 12 months, b) a summary of background check coverage and what is retained, and c) your offboarding checklist and evidence that access is revoked promptly.

Can you send redacted artifacts we can include in the assessment? We typically accept: LMS completion reports, a one-page background-check summary (no PII), and an exported offboarding checklist CSV or spreadsheet. We prefer everything redacted for IDs and DOBs.

Timeline: we are hoping to wrap this in two business days. Please let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Lara Chen
Senior Security Analyst
Acme Corp

--
Attachment: request-template.pdf (pdf)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for employee training & background checks

Hi Lara — thanks for the clear list. We can provide the artifacts you outlined. High-level plan:

- Laura will pull the LMS completion exports and scrub identifying fields.
- I will generate an internal summary of our background-check coverage (vendor + scope) and provide a redacted PDF.
- Vivek will export the offboarding checklist from the HRIS and include timestamps showing access deprovisioning.

Two business days is tight but doable — we will start with redacted samples and then provide the full evidence bundle.

Questions for you: do you need hashed employee IDs (we can provide) or should we leave IDs blank? Also, please confirm the preferred method for delivery (Drive folder vs. upload to your secure portal).

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Ben / Vivek / Lara,

Attached are the first artifacts: an LMS completion export for the security module (redacted), and a short CSV with hire/termination dates and role categories (employee IDs removed). I also uploaded the full folder to the Drive link below.

Notes:
- The LMS export shows course completion timestamp and course version; names are hashed (sha256) in the export.
- Background checks are carried out at offer acceptance for roles with access to customer data; I included a one-page summary (vendor, scope, frequency) as a PDF.
- Offboarding evidence: the HRIS export lists termination date and date of deprovisioning for systems; we included a cross-check against Active Directory log removals for the few samples.

Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/Acme/employee-evidence-2026

I will follow up with the redacted background summary PDF and the offboarding checklist export by EOD.

Laura Bennett
Head of People Ops (Security liaison)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-02-11_onboarding-training-roster-redacted.csv, redacted-offboarding-sample.xlsx
From: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-corp.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 08:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for employee training & background checks

Thanks Laura — the initial artifacts look good. A couple quick follow-ups from our security review team:

1) Retention: can you confirm how long you retain background-check records and training completions? We need a written retention period for our report.
2) Offboarding proof: for terminated staff, we need a sample that shows account termination time and confirmation that access to the hosted inference environment is removed. Can you include one or two redacted examples?

If you can provide both items and the redacted background summary by end of day, we can mark this item as satisfied for the CAIQ.

Best,
Lara
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Chen <lara.chen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Acme Procurement <procurement@acme-corp.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2026 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: evidence for employee training & background checks

Lara — quick status update and final package delivery.

What we delivered (attached and in Drive):
- 2026-02-11_onboarding-training-roster-redacted.csv (LMS export, hashed IDs)
- 2026-02-11_background-check-summary.pdf (vendor + scope, no PII)
- 2026-02-12_offboarding-checklist-export.xlsx (HRIS export showing termination + deprovision timestamps)
- redacted_offer-letter-ids.pdf (redacted offer IDs for verification)

Retention policy (for report): background-check summaries and training completion records are retained for 7 years after termination; operational access logs are retained for 365 days (longer retention available under enterprise contract).

Offboarding sample: in the offboarding spreadsheet we included two redacted samples that show termination at 2025-11-02 09:23:00 UTC and deprovision timestamp 2025-11-02 09:27:13 UTC (4-minute window). Screenshots of AD removal are included in the Drive folder.

Delivery method: Drive link above (shared with Lara and security@acme-corp.com). If you prefer an encrypted upload to your portal or a signed DocuSign acknowledgment of receipt, we can do that — included a DocuSign link for acceptance if needed.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — let us know if anything else is required.

Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: 2026-02-11_onboarding-training-roster-redacted.csv; 2026-02-11_background-check-summary.pdf; 2026-02-12_offboarding-checklist-export.xlsx; redacted_offer-letter-ids.pdf
